অর্থ মন্ত্রণালয়

জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড।

(কাস্টমস)

প্রজ্ঞাপন

National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the authorized government body within the Ministry of Finance responsible for issuing customs-related notifications and statutory orders.
Government of Bangladesh: The Government of Bangladesh, acting through the Ministry of Finance and the Internal Resources Division, serves as the issuing authority for this statutory instrument.

processed_clauses.resolved_text:
তারিখ : ২৩ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২০ বঙ্গাব্দ/০৬ জুন, ২০১৩ খ্রিস্টাব্দ।

এস.আর.ও. নং- ১৫৯-আইন/২০১৩/২৪৪৬/কাস্টমস।- Customs Act, 1969 (Act IV of 1969) এর section 219, উক্ত Act এর THIRD SCHEDULE এর Item ১৭ এর সহিত পঠিতব্য, এ প্রদত্ত ক্ষমতাবলে জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড, যাত্রী (অপযটক) ব্যাগেজ (আমদানি) বিধিমালা, ২০১২ এর নিম্নরূপ সংশোধন করিল, যথা:-

Customs Act 1969: This Act provides the legal authority under section 219, read in conjunction with the Third Schedule, for the National Board of Revenue to issue amendments to customs-related rules.
National Board of Revenue: The Board is empowered by the Customs Act to amend existing baggage rules regarding the import of goods by non-tourist passengers.
Passenger (Non-Tourist) Baggage (Import): These rules are being amended by the National Board of Revenue through this Statutory Regulatory Order to update the regulatory framework for baggage imports.
Third Schedule: The Third Schedule of the Customs Act is referenced as part of the legal basis for exercising the authority to amend baggage rules.

Passenger Baggage Rules: The rules are amended to increase the quantity of alcoholic beverages a passenger may import as baggage.
The duty-free allowance threshold for passengers arriving via land routes is increased.
The quantity of personal items a passenger may import is increased for specific baggage categories.
The timeframe or limit for certain baggage procedures has been extended.
Import Policy Order: The reference to the previous Import Policy Order in the baggage rules is updated to reflect the current version covering a new period.
Customs Tariff Schedule: The duty rates for specific items listed in the schedule are revised downwards.
Specifications for certain goods listed in the schedule are updated to align with new dimensional or technical standards.
